verdict: Cadence is load-bearing but NOT sufficient. Moving from the toy cadence to the production cadence the 40h organism actually ran cuts (a) from 17.9x to 7.09x and (c) from 3.79x to 2.22x — both roughly halve, confirming the register diagnosis that these ratios were partly measuring fixed overheads. Neither clears its threshold. So the register entry is only half right: the toy cadence inflated the numbers, but a real residual remains at production cadence, and (a)/(c) as registered do NOT pass on a single Mac. (b) state parity passes at every cadence, unchanged.
